body:
## Summary

Implements the \"Delete Saves\" button requested in Issue #938.

- **New button** in the Experimental Features menu labeled **\"Delete Saves\"** (with a \"Delete\" action button)
- Pressing it **erases all game progress**: completed level scores/ranks, unlocked weapons, unlocked grenades, unlocked active items
- The game returns to its **first-launch state** (only Makarov PM weapon + Flashbang grenade available by default)
- **Experimental settings are preserved** (FOV, AI Prediction, Debug Mode, etc. are untouched)
- Status label shows \"Saves deleted. Game reset to first-launch state.\" feedback after the button is pressed

## Changes

### `scripts/autoload/persist_manager.gd`
- Added `clear_all_saves()`: deletes `user://game_state.cfg`, resets `GameManager` weapon state, `GrenadeManager` grenade state, `ActiveItemManager` active item state to defaults, and calls `ProgressManager.clear_all_progress()`

### `scenes/ui/ExperimentalMenu.tscn`
- Added `DeleteSavesContainer` (HBoxContainer with label + button), `DeleteSavesDescription` label, and `HSeparator9` between the Logging section and Enemy Flashlight Blinding section

### `scripts/ui/experimental_menu.gd`
- Added `@onready` reference for `delete_saves_button`
- Connected `delete_saves_button.pressed` → `_on_delete_saves_pressed()`
- Added `_on_delete_saves_pressed()` handler that calls `PersistManager.clear_all_saves()` and updates the status label

### `tests/unit/test_delete_saves.gd` (new)
- 17 unit tests covering: weapon reset, grenade reset, active item reset, level progress cleared, save file removed, full scenario, and idempotency

## Test plan

- [ ] Open Experimental Features menu — see "Delete Saves" row with a "Delete" button
- [ ] Complete a level, unlock a weapon in armory, then press "Delete" → status label shows feedback
- [ ] Return to main menu — only Makarov PM is unlocked, level progress is gone
- [ ] Re-open Experimental Features menu — all toggles still have their previous values (not reset)
- [ ] Run unit tests: `tests/unit/test_delete_saves.gd`

Issue: https://github.com/Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP/issues/938

Adds a "Delete Saves" button to the Experimental Features menu that
resets all game progress (completed levels, unlocked weapons/grenades/
active items) to first-launch state while preserving experimental
settings.

- PersistManager.clear_all_saves(): deletes save file, resets
  GameManager/GrenadeManager/ActiveItemManager to defaults, clears
  ProgressManager level progress
- ExperimentalMenu.tscn: new DeleteSaves row with label, button, and
  description; preceded by separator
- experimental_menu.gd: wires up DeleteSavesButton; shows feedback in
  status label on press
- tests/unit/test_delete_saves.gd: unit tests covering weapon, grenade,
  active item and progress resets, full scenario and idempotency
